mil3.7.6:1.2: Kati nu kho bhante Nāgasena bojjhangā ti. -
mil3.7.6:1.5: Ekena kho mahārāja bojjhangena bujjhati: dhammavicayasambojjhangenāti.
mil3.7.6:1.6: Atha kissa nu kho bhante vuccanti satta bojjhangā ti.
mil3.7.6:1.7: Taṃ kim-maññasi mahārāja: asi kosiyā pakkhitto aggahito hatthena ussahati chejjaṃ chinditun-ti. -
mil3.7.6:1.9: Evam-eva kho mahārāja dhammavicayasambojjhangena vinā chahi bojjhangehi na bujjhatīti.
